description: Kalshi signing vectors. RSA-PSS-SHA256 (salt length 32, MGF1-SHA256) uses a random salt, so signatures are never byte-identical between signers; what must match exactly is the signing string. A signer is correct when its base64 signature over `signingString` verifies with the account's public key. Shared with downstream (e.g. Rust) signer implementations.

requests.note: The WebSocket handshake signs the WS path, not the REST prefix.
